What to find: How and why key design choices in training were made.

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Post-training follows the standard SFT → RL → on-policy distillation (OPD) paradigm without algorithmic modifications, with all substantive changes in the data pipeline (large-scale automated synthesis of agent tasks and environments, progressive scaling of data, tasks, and rollouts). Architecturally, the Causal Encoder-Decoder projects the decoder's global KV cache from final encoder hidden states, activating only 8B parameters per token during prefill and 16B during decode to improve cost efficiency for input-heavy agentic workloads.
quotes: **Post-training.** The post-training recipe follows the standard SFT → RL → on-policy distillation (OPD) paradigm without algorithmic modifications. All substantive changes lie instead in the data pipeline: large-scale automated synthesis of agent tasks and environments with progressive scaling of data, tasks, and rollouts.
This allows the model to activate only **8B parameters per token during prefill** and **16B during decode**, substantially improving cost efficiency for input-heavy agentic workloads.
